content.outro: You left the court with your eyes still adjusting, and nothing followed you out.
content.premise: A walled court with three levers in three shallow alcoves and a lava pit behind a rail at its north end. Each lever makes the world go wrong for a moment — for whoever pulled it, for whoever is in the court, or for everyone.
content.theme: A court where something looks back at you for a moment.
content.title: Something Looks Back
